notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Bounty Hunter.
Bounty Hunter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Bounty Hunter's first ability by tapping it, targeting any nonblack creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Bounty Hunter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a nonblack creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
